## Copper Kettle – Eval Runner
Runs the 12 test documents (data table **p3_eval_cases**, PDFs in Drive `test-set`) through the real invoice processor in eval mode (it stops before Drive, Airtable, QuickBooks and Slack), checks every result with code against the answer key, and reports the score.

**1. Load cases** → **2. Run and check each case** → **3. Summarize**

Before a run: write what changed in NOTE inside "Start Run". Raise CRITERIA_VERSION when a check or a case changes; scores are only compared within one version. One Gemini call per document, 5 seconds apart (free tier: 15 per minute).

### 1. Load cases
Reads the answer key in order and finds each PDF in Drive by file name. ONLY in "Start Run" limits a quick test to a few cases.

### 2. Run and check each case
The invoice processor reads the PDF and decides the route. **Code decides pass or fail** in five groups: Routing, Facts (printed values), Safety (nothing invented, no number "fixed"), Format, Allocation (store and category per line). Earlier documents of the run are passed on, so a re-sent invoice is caught as a duplicate.

### 3. Summarize
Score, score per group, accuracy per field and per line (store, category), score per case type, Gemini seconds per document, change since the last run with the same criteria, and failed cases. Saved to **eval_runs** and posted to #eval-runs.
